name: random-headgear-box
author: rhwski
description: Every monster can drop a Random Headgear Box (0.05% by default). Opening one gives a random headgear that nothing in the stock item database drops or sells: 417 in pre-renewal (Snake Head and Skull Cap among them), 1207 in renewal. Works in both eras.

settings.label: Box drop chance (units of 0.01%)
settings.description: Chance per monster kill. 5 = 0.05%, 100 = 1%, 0 = no drops.
